newsitem.title: ITALY: INA to decide Dec 17 on Banco Napoli bid.
newsitem.headline: INA to decide Dec 17 on Banco Napoli bid.

text.p: The board of Italian insurer INA will decide formally on December 17 whether to bid for a 60 percent stake in struggling Banco di Napoli, the head of one of INA's shareholders said on Friday.
Gianni Zandano, chairman of INA shareholder San Paolo bank, said at a banking meeting here there were no disagreements about the operation to bid for the stake in the loss-making southern bank.
"We hope for a positive outcome but we first have to examine the documents and clarify the bank's situation," Zandano said.
The Italian Treasury wants to sell 60 percent of Banco di Napoli's stock and has given interested parties until December 20 to make offers.
Zandano also sits on the board of INA, which together with Treasury-controlled Banco Nazionale di Lavoro (BNL) has stated an initial interest in bidding for Banco di Napoli.
The Treasury took temporary control of Banco di Napoli after it unveiled record losses of 3.12 trillion lire in 1995 and plunged a further 674 billion into the red in the first half of this year.
